summary: CCC-built 1935 steel fire tower (86 ft) in McCormick's Creek State Park, Indiana; active until 1967, restored and reopened to the public in 2020.

facts.design: Steel watch tower with a 7x7 ft steel cab, triangular landings and diagonal stairs

access.note: Open to visitors in McCormick's Creek State Park along hiking trail #4. Reopened in August 2020 after restoration, per Clio. Sources disagree on how long it was closed.

visit.trail_note: Along hiking trail #4 in McCormick's Creek State Park.

events.note: Constructed by CCC Company #589. The park history says CCC men completed work in the park between November 1933 and July 1935, including the firetower.
Tower operated as a fire lookout through 1967.
Public access closed in the early 1980s due to lack of maintenance and disrepair (Clio).
Listed on the National Historic Lookout Register on November 12, 2008.
Repairs began in July, per a December 2018 Indiana Landmarks article.
Reopened to the public in August 2020 after fundraising and repairs (Clio).

corrections.why: The National Historic Lookout Register and Indiana Landmarks both give 86 ft (about 26.2 m). The 30.5 m (100 ft) in the record is not supported by either page.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: NHLR and Indiana Landmarks give 86 ft. Search snippets (not fetched pages) also mention 90 ft and about 100 ft; the story uses 86 ft, the figure both fetched sources state.

Indiana Landmarks (2018) expected the tower to open for the first time in nearly 30 years; Clio says it had been closed for nearly forty years and reopened in August 2020. Both are reported; not resolved.
Indiana Landmarks recommended a $10,000 grant and reports a further $85,000 from donors; Clio gives $100,000 raised in total. Both reported; the sums are not reconciled.

notes_for_editor: Record height 30.5 m (100 ft) corrected to 26.2 m (86 ft) per NHLR and Indiana Landmarks. Living New Deal (about 100 ft, completed 1934) and Wikipedia (90 ft) appeared only in search results and were not read; not used. Clio is a student-created entry (2020) that cites WBIW Aug 2020, not read; its reopening date and closure length are reported as Clio's claims. Access marked public from Clio and Indiana Landmarks; no current park page on hours or climbing was read. NHLR visit form leaves the staffing question unanswered. Current elevation_m 234.7 matches NHLR 770 ft (235 m). No new photos added.
